{{Quote|Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on the forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|[[Ketu]], of the non&ndash;Force-sensitive Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1" />}}
'''Furies Gate''' was the outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The cold and barren world was colonized more than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Several thousand years before [[25,793 BBY]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[Fury Station]] was established in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Furies Gate and for a long period of [[Time/Legends|time]] served as a launch point of Tythan [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] traveling into the Deep Core. By 25,793 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the station still orbited Furies Gate and served as a scientific outpost.

==Description==
[[File:Fury_Station.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Fury Station]] in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Furies Gate]]
Furies Gate was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] L-10.<ref name="EAOC" />  It was a 300-day flight from the planet [[Kalimahr]].<ref name="Void" /> The world occupied the eleventh&mdash;the outermost&mdash;[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]] [[Tythos]],<ref name="DotJ0" /> and was a cold,<ref name="DotJ1" /> mostly barren planet that appeared to be brown in [[Color/Legends|color]] from [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. A [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[Fury Station]] orbited Furies Gate, with the station's crew being the only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] presence on the desolate world.<ref name="DotJ0" />

==History==
More than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> Furies Gate was colonized by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]<ref name="DotJ1" />&mdash;the fifth planet of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="DotJ0" />&mdash;[[Second migration|traveling]] to Tython's neighboring worlds.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Several thousand years before<ref name="DotJ2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref> [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> Fury Station was established in orbit around Furies Gate, and, over the millennia since its establishment, the station was used as a launch point of several Tythan [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] that traveled into the Deep Core.<ref name="DotJ2" /> By 25,793 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> Fury Station still orbited Furies Gate and was run as a scientific outpost<ref name="DotJ0" /> under strict treaty by the [[Settled Worlds]] of the Tython system.<ref name="DotJ2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Furies Gate was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planet was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Furies Gate's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The planet was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] issue of the series and made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second]] issue&mdash;published on [[February 15]] and [[March 21]] of the same year, respectively.
